Edyta Sliwinska: World-Class Dance Expert Edyta Sliwinska is a world-renowned ballroom dancer, instructor, and fan-favorite professional from the hit television series Dancing with the Stars . With over two decades of professional experience, she brings unmatched expertise, charisma, and a passion for movement to every environment.

Having built her reputation by successfully teaching celebrities with no prior dance experience, Edyta is an expert at breaking down complex movements into accessible steps. Her expertise extends beyond the dance floor; she has choreographed and performed in numerous stage productions, live shows, and events around the world. She specializes in bridging the gap between high-level technique and engaging experiences for all skill levels. She is uniquely positioned to elevate your corporate events, team-building workshops, or wellness programs by transforming the art of ballroom dance into a powerful tool for collaboration, confidence, and stress relief.

Whether she is leading an energetic introductory session or a sophisticated masterclass, Edyta delivers a professional and memorable experience that motivates participants and fosters genuine connection.

Dance Your Team to Its Best Performance
More Than Entertainment — A Team Accelerator
paragraphs: Home Corporate Weddings Podcast Blog Contact Us About Kids Account

Dance Your Team to Its Best Performance I’m Edyta Śliwińska from Dancing with the Stars. For over a decade, I’ve brought joy, precision, and energy to millions on TV. Now, I’m bringing that same star power straight to your office, your retreat, or your next company event, because dance isn’t just entertainment. It’s the ultimate team accelerator.

Imagine this: instead of another trust fall or PowerPoint icebreaker, your team steps onto the dance floor—laughing, moving, and connecting. My corporate dance classes are custom-built, high-energy sessions designed to fit perfectly into your workday, whether it's a lunch-hour class, a pre-meeting session, or a full-day retreat. We make it seamless. Dance isn't just fun—it's science-backed team magic. In just 45–60 minutes, we skyrocket endorphins, slash stress, and spark creativity. Teams that dance together communicate better, collaborate bolder, and innovate faster. No experience? No problem. I break down every step—Samba, Swing, Hip-Hop—with zero judgment and maximum encouragement. We scale for 5 or 500 participants, hybrid or in-person, with the highest level of instruction and playlists that pulse.
Let’s turn your next meeting into a movement. Book a 15-minute discovery call—I’ll design a session that leaves your team buzzing and bonded.

Zero Judgment. Maximum Energy. No Experience Required — Seriously More Than Entertainment — A Team Accelerator For over a decade, I've brought joy, precision, and energy to millions on television. Now, I'm channeling that same expertise into something far more impactful: transforming how your team connects, communicates, and performs together. Dance isn't a novelty — it's a proven vehicle for human connection, and when applied in a corporate setting, the results are measurable and lasting.

Imagine this: instead of another trust fall exercise or a PowerPoint icebreaker that nobody remembers by Friday, your team steps onto the dance floor — laughing, moving, and connecting in a way that feels entirely natural. There's something powerful that happens when people share physical rhythm. Barriers dissolve. Hierarchies soften. Real relationships form — fast.

My corporate dance sessions are custom-built, high-energy experiences designed to fit seamlessly into your workday. Whether it's a lunch-hour energizer, a pre-meeting warm-up, or the centerpiece of a full-day offsite retreat, we make every logistical detail effortless so you can focus on what matters: your people. No awkward transitions, no complicated setup. Just movement, music, and momentum.

headings: Edyta Sliwinska from Dancing with the stars
Edyta Sliwinska from Dancing with the stars
Elevate Your Wedding Dance with Edyta Sliwinska
Why Choose Edyta Sliwinska's Dream Wedding Dance Package?
Your first dance, without the fear.
paragraphs: Home Corporate Weddings Podcast Blog Contact Us About Kids Account

Elevate Your Wedding Dance with Edyta Sliwinska Experience the Magic of Dance: Personalized Choreography: Tailored just for you by Edyta Sliwinska, a celebrated professional from "Dancing with the Stars." Let her expertise transform your first dance into a memorable performance. Private Lessons: One-on-one sessions to ensure your dance is not only beautiful but also uniquely yours. Learn from the best in the industry. Dance Styles: From elegant ballroom to contemporary flair, choose or mix styles that reflect your love story. Venue Coordination: We'll work with your venue to set up the perfect dance floor, lighting, and music, ensuring every detail complements your dance. Rehearsal Space: Exclusive access to professional studios for your practice sessions, ensuring privacy and focus. Performance Day Support: On your wedding day, Edyta and her team will be there to give you that final boost of confidence, making sure everything goes smoothly.

Star Quality: With Edyta's experience from "Dancing with the Stars," your dance will have the polish and professionalism of a TV show performance. Memorable Moments: Your first dance is more than just a dance; it's a story of your journey together, beautifully choreographed. Exclusive Attention: Edyta's personal touch ensures your dance is as unique as your relationship.

Edyta builds a wedding dance that feels like you — even if you’ve never danced before. Private lessons for Bay Area couples, tech founders, athletes, and anyone who wants that “how did they do that?” moment.

Customized Learning: Each lesson is designed around your skill level, ensuring you both feel comfortable and confident. Whether you're starting from scratch or have some dance experience, Edyta will adapt the lessons to your needs

Intimate Sessions: Enjoy the undivided attention of a world-class instructor. These private sessions focus on technique, style, and emotional expression, making your dance not just a step-by-step routine but a heartfelt performance. Flexible Scheduling: With private lessons, you set the pace. Whether you need intensive sessions close to the wedding or spread out over months, Edyta will work with your timeline. Dance Style Exploration: Dive into various dance styles or stick to one. From the romantic waltz to the energetic cha-cha, or even contemporary moves, your lessons will be as diverse as your love story. Feedback and Improvement: Edyta provides detailed feedback, helping you refine your movements and expressions for the perfect dance.
